requirements.title: External provider scope is transportable
requirements.description: The provider descriptor carries EXTERNAL scope and the registration contract remains usable for paid or external corpora.

validation.notes: Add an external-scope registration and routing contract test when an external provider is selected.

requirements.title: Group-scoped federation remains explicit
requirements.description: A future --group selector can reproduce a scenario's unified search through Search Hub without changing the owning scenario's search surface.

validation.notes: Add a group-scope contract test when the owning scenario exposes the required group search semantics.

requirements.title: Federation coverage is measurable
requirements.description: The registry can eventually report registered live leaves divided by the known-corpus denominator as the Track-A adoption gauge.

validation.notes: Add a coverage-measure contract test once the known-corpus denominator is owned by a stable registry.
